# host: # Inventory for `devstack migrate` (MAMP → Valet) and the protected-site list. This file is an example: copy it to
# sites.local.tsv (git-ignored) and fill in your sites; sites.local.tsv wins when it exists.
#   host       = the site name: https://<host>.test and the Valet link name
#   folder     = directory under ~/Sites (usually the same as host)
#   php        = php@X.Y the site runs on (7.4 … 8.6)
#   db         = the MAMP database to copy, or - for a site without WordPress
#   protected  = yes shields a site from remove/archive and from batch migration (restore only while absent)

notes: static export, link and secure only
